lines.say: He drove forty-one miles to dodge a barber ten minutes away.
Every two weeks, for nine years. Nearly twenty thousand fucking miles for a haircut.
And all because his barber raised the price five dollars and never said a damn word about it.
No text. No heads up. Just a new number on the sign.
caps: Just *a new number* on the sign.

lines.say: So he left without a word. The barber told everybody that guy was a flaky son of a bitch.
Meanwhile the guy told ninety-one people that barber was a prick. He counted.
I made that guy up. But you've got three of him on your books right now.
Message Health shows you who they are, and sends the text you never got around to.
Comment KEEP to get a full retention audit.
